title: The Summit 1216 - Condo with Seasonal Beach Chairs
description:
Gulf Front Condo With Views - Seasonal Beach Chairs Included!

The space
1 Bedroom, 1.5 Baths,  Sleeps 5, Washer/Dryer combo all in one unit
Bedroom - King, Common Space - Sleeper sofa, Bunk Bed

*FREE Beach Seasonal Beach Service (Mar 1-Oct 31, 2025)

Minimum age to book is 18+

Check-in is at 4 PM CT (5 PM Spring Break and Major Holidays)
When checking in, please register at the front desk to receive your parking pass and wristbands. The registration fee is $27.00 per vehicle (subject to change without prior notice).

This comfortable, easy, and relaxing Summit condo will give you the majestic Gulf views and the enviable beachfront location you've been dreaming of! Spend your days kicking back on the private balcony, feeling the white sand beneath your toes, and enjoying on-site resort amenities such as a seasonally heated swimming pool, a poolside tiki bar, hot tubs, and a fitness center, all in a prime Panama City Beach location.

The Summit is a Gulf-front resort on the white sand of Panama City Beach - an ideal retreat for families, beach-goers, and anglers. Take a half-mile stroll to fish for flounder, king mackerel, and redfish at the Russell-Fields Pier, and peruse more than 100 retailers, excellent restaurants, cinemas, and all sorts of entertainment at Pier Park. With the perfect location to fit your every need, what's not to love?!

Experience the best of Panama City Beach from this perfectly located property right next to Tootsie’s Orchid Lounge! Walk to live music, nightlife, restaurants, and nearby beach attractions. Ideal for couples, friends, and vacation groups looking for fun and convenience.

IMPORTANT:
Per PCB Ordinance 1632, maximum occupancy is 5 guests INCLUDING children and infant-Failure to abide by the ordinance may result in a fine and possible ejection. VRC# 43168

reviews.text: Victoria was an amazing host! She was very responsive and helpful with getting us into her beautiful condo. The condo was exactly as described. Zero issues during my stay. The bed was super comfy and all linens were nice and clean. Two smart televisions in the condo with a furnished and full kitchen. I strongly recommend staying in this beautiful condo. Elevation was perfect for viewing the water and both directions of the beach. Location was pristine, right beside the new and beautiful Tootsie’s Lounge. Directly across the street from sling shot and go cart racing. The amenities at this condo are also amazing. No disappointment was had!
reviews.response:
Thank you so much for your incredible review! I'm truly grateful for your kind words. I'm delighted to hear that you enjoyed the condo, the comfortable bed, the clean linens, and all the amenities. It means a lot to know that the condo met your expectations and that you found everything exactly as described.
I'm also glad you enjoyed the location, the beautiful views, and being so close to many of Panama City Beach's attractions. It's wonderful to hear that communication was smooth and that you experienced zero issues during your stay. Thank you again for your recommendation. It was an absolute pleasure hosting you, and I would love to welcome you back for another stay in the future!

reviews.text:
First, Victoria was wonderful to work with and the Summit had some great features. The large pools and the includes chair rental were great! The king bed in the master was comfy. Here are a few of the reasons we didn’t give a five star rating.
-It was bit tight for a family of five. Next time we will select a condo with two bedrooms instead of the bunks beds in the hall.
-The kitchen was tiny. As in only one person could stand in it. If you aren’t planning to cook in, you will be fine.
-Living room seating was limited. One sofa and one recliner. For a family who winds down watching movies in the evening, it was not very comfortable. One kid or parent made a palette on the floor with pillows.
reviews.response:
Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a thoughtful and detailed review. I’m really glad to hear you enjoyed working with me, the Summit’s amenities, the pools, chair rentals, and that the king bed was comfortable.
I truly appreciate your honest feedback as well. Your points about the space, kitchen size, and living room seating are completely valid, especially for a family of five. This is really helpful insight for future guests so they can choose the layout that best fits their needs, and for me as I look for ways to improve the experience where possible.
I’m grateful you stayed with us and shared your experience, and I’d absolutely love to host you again—hopefully next time in a layout that’s an even better fit for your family. Thanks again!

reviews.text: The view of the ocean was beautiful. Very clean place to stay. I would recommend it to anyone to stay at the Summit!
reviews.response: Heather, I'm so glad everything worked out for you and you were able to enjoy your stay.  I look forward to your return!

reviews.text:
The unit looks like the photos. The location was nice, there’s a mini golf place in front of it. The host was responsive, though issues weren’t really resolved. The elevators were very slow. The pools closed early.
My real issue is that when we arrived to the unit, there was an immediate smell to the unit of wet dog/humidity/sewage. I messaged the host and the response was to set the thermostat to 72…when I pressed her on it and asked for at least an air freshener , a cleaner brought that which at least made the smell bearable.
The couch was dirty and had sand and the decorative pillows had stains on it. I asked if the room was cleaned because of the obvious issues but the response was only a yes it was cleaned.
The bathroom toilet seats look old stained from use and the shower was not cleaned.
I would not stay here again, due to lack of cleanliness.
reviews.response:
Dear Silvia,
Thanks for visiting! The complex has 4 elevators and I contacted the COA after reading you reviews, They did not have any elevators issues during that time frame . However, it was a Holiday weekend and we were at full capacity so longer wait is expected. The pool closure early is temporary and listed at booking and prior to arrival as well. You did mention sand on the couch but none of the many issues listed here . I wish I knew as I would have handle it. Yes, it was very humid when you came ...I am sorry. Hope you did enjoyed our beautiful beaches!

reviews.text:
The building is conveniently positioned near a beautiful, clean beach. The apartment provides a beautiful view of the gulf. The balcony is quite spacious and enjoyable. Overall, the flat is lovely, but the owner needs to do more maintenance: broken toilet, messy and stinky kitchen cabinets. The whole point of getting an apartment for us was to be able to cook our own food, and seeing overused cooking pans and sticky glasses was not nice.
The host was swift to resolve the difficulties, and we enjoyed the ease of communication.
reviews.response:
Dear Victoria,
Thanks for visiting! The previous guests did not report the issues you noticed...I am sorry. However, I am glad I had you fix it promptly as well as the other things you were not pleased with. We are not perfect, but we pride ourselves in getting it right if something is wrong. It was a pleasure having you, and I hope you created memories.

title: 25th Floor Penthouse | Sunrise Beach | Beachfront!
description:
Step inside this luxurious penthouse, featuring a spacious open layout, and granite countertop breakfast bar! The living area and Master bedroom both open to a large private balcony that is perfect for sipping your morning coffee or enjoying a sunset cocktail while overlooking the emerald coast.

The space
The penthouse:
Direct gulf-front views – Clear ocean vistas from your large private balcony

Resort-Style Amenities – 2 Gulf-front pools, hot tub, kid’s splash pad, fitness center, & grills

Convenient beachfront access – Private entrance just steps from the Emerald Coast

Prime Location – Located only minutes from Pier Park, shopping, and nightlife

Elegant Master Bathroom Suite – Walk in Shower and Garden Tub

Large Living Area – Queen Sleeper Sofa and comfortable furniture

Fully Equipped Kitchen – Granite Countertops, Stainless steel appliances & drip coffee maker

Dining Area – Breakfast Bar with seating

Fast WiFi + Smart TVs – Stay connected and stream your favorite shows

Covered Garage Parking – (Guests pay $50 per vehicle)

Resort Amenities:
Private Beach Access – Walk straight from the resort to the white sands reserved specifically for Sunrise Beach Resort guests!

2 Gulf-Front Pools & Hot Tub – One pool is heated seasonally!

Fitness Center – Overlooks the ocean, perfect for a vacation workout

BBQ Grills & Picnic Area – Ideal for a beachside cookout

Quick Walk To Pier Park! – shopping, dining, & entertainment a quick walk away

Family fun – Gulf World Marine Park, Shipwreck Island, mini golf, and more

SEASONAL BEACH SERVICE (March - October):
We offer a discounted $55 BEACH SERVICE rental fee for reservations between Mar 15 - Oct 31. This includes two chairs and an umbrella for your entire stay. The Beach vendor charges $45/day rental so this potentially could save you more than $200 for a week stay. Let us know if you want to take advantage of the beach service.

Guest access
Keyless access – Guests will be provided with a code and detailed arrival instructions at least 24 hours before check-in via the airbnb messenger

Private access – Rental of this direct beachfront condo provides complete exclusive access to the unit. Guests will also have shared access to resort amenities with other guests and members.

Amenity access – Guests will also have shared access to resort amenities with other guests and members of Sunrise Beach Resort

Parking/resort fee – There is a one-time fee of $50 per vehicle registered

Registration portal – Link to the resort’s registration portal will be sent via email a week before your arrival and must be completed before check-in

Check-in – 10:00am | Check out – 4:00pm

Other things to note
Minimum age requirement – At least one guest must be 25 years or older to book

Registration details – Guests must complete online resort registration before arrival; details will be provided one week before check-in

Basics provided – We provide all of the necessities to get you settled in and relaxed, and there is a grocery store close by for you to pick up or replenish any items that you may need for the remainder of your stay (Please also note beach towels are not provided with our linens)

Terms and conditions – All guests automatically agree to the terms and conditions of the rental agreement when booking the property. Feel free to contact us for the rental agreement Terms and Conditions prior to booking.

reviews.text: This condo was in the heart of Panama City Beach. Easy access to anything you need! I expected more disruptions but things were pretty low key. We stayed in early March.  The only thing to note was that Marijuana use is legal and was used by other tenants below, effecting our air quality on several occasions.
reviews.response:
Thanks for the detailed review Hannah!
Also for the record, marijuana use is prohibited by the state of Florida, unless medical, and smoking of all types on the balcony is also not permitted by the resort, so please don't think we or the resort condone this!
In the future please don't be afraid to reach out to your host and we can take care of issues like that :)
Thanks so much for staying with us and we hope to host you again in the future!

reviews.text: Ultimately the price point was good for what we got and would suggest staying here. Very nice location and view.
It’s was so beautiful and so relaxing perfect little get away
Hi

Some repairs were needed such as the fan in the bedroom, shower curtain rod, & the ice machine wouldn't dispense ice. TV's were pretty small too. The condo had great view & good location on the strip!

Place was clean easy to find and easy check in. Views were absolutely beautiful. Never waited long for elevator even being on 25 th floor. Beach chairs were a great investment for the week. Clean inside.

I can’t say enough positive things about this condo and Anthony.  This was our first visit to PCB and the condo was everything we had hoped for.  The convenience of having a full kitchen and living room was great for the rainy day while there.  The balcony view was breathtaking.  The price was right in our budget, the pools and hot tubs were so nice on those double red flag days.  Being right on the beach with a gulf view was perfect.  10/10 recommend booking this condo and working with Anthony.
Three of my friends and I stayed here this past week and it was wonderful! The host was very responsive and being right on the beach was so nice. This is a very nice place!

The view from the balcony was awesome. That’s  where we spent most of our time. The condo had everything basic anyone should need. The host was on point with everything we asked. Hope to come back soon in the future. Walmart is 2 blocks away and pier and park is 5 minutes down the main drag.
The condo was absolutely beautiful and just like described. We loved being on the 25th floor and having the view we did. Definitely will be renting this condo for our next beach vacation getaway!!
Great Area and good host.
The condo was as advertised. The view was incredible. It was vestry comfortable.

Beautiful view!!! We love Sunrise beach resort! We’ve stayed there several times. It’s a great location and so convenient with parking right under the condo building which allows easy access from your vehicle to the beach to store beach toys, chairs without needing to haul them back to the condo. There’s a grill on-site too.

Anthony was a great host. He communicated very well. The condo was wonderful with a beautiful view of the ocean. The condo is on the top floor of the condominium. Location was in walking distance to bars, stores and a few restaurants.
It would’ve been better if we could’ve been able to smoke at least on the balcony but overall we really enjoyed our stay!

Great room overlooking the ocean! Anthony was great and easy to communicate with when needed. Check in and out was a breeze. I will say the only downfall is that there are only 4 elevators and you can wait a while for them during busy times. This is not a huge deal because it’s like that most places around here. All in all I would definitely stay here again.

Pictures are accurate. The views are amazing! Easy access to the beach! Close to Pier Park and a lot of Restaurants and other attractions! Clean and organized! Host was very punctual with any questions we had! We would recommend staying here and hopefully we will get a chance to go back!
5 ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️’s from us!

Beautiful view and great location. We could walk to multiple restaurants and we never had to use our car. Master bedroom comfortable, but front bedroom gets terribly hot and was uncomfortable.  Very small and needs a fan in there or something to keep it cool.  Anthony was easy to communicate with and answered back fast. Pictures very accurate of the unit.  Elevators were good and fast except during the busy times.

This unit was perfect for a weekend getaway with friends! It’s location is very convenient to the popular spots on PCB and just minutes away from Pier Park! And the view is INCREDIBLE, we spent so much time out on the balcony drinking coffee and sipping wine, we will definitely stay here again in the future!

Stunning views from the balcony the 25th floor is amazing. We saw a few dolphins, a manatee, a sea turtle, a jellyfish, and many stingrays with our binoculars it was great seeing all of the marine life...the decor is a little dated but the view makes up for it. It didn’t bother us one bit. I made lasagna while there so there is plenty of dishes to cook with !

Our family of 5 enjoyed our stay here. The host was very responsive to our messages so A+ on communication. We loved the location being on the 25th floor and right on the beach. Our only “complaint” would be that the beds were very uncomfortable. Kind of glad we only stayed 2 nights because my back would have been unhappy beyond that. New mattresses and bedding would make this place perfect, but still give it 5 stars and our recommendation!

Anthony’s place was GREAT! It is just as pictured. The condo is in an amazing location and the view can’t be beat.  My family and I would love to stay here again.  Also worth noting the elevators are fast in this building unlike others we have stayed in a waited 10+ minutes.  Everyone was friendly and Anthony is very fast with responses. Having a washer and dryer in the unit and a Walmart about 8 mins away is very convenient.

The views are amazing. The condo is on the 25th floor and we saw sea life almost every evening from the balcony. We stayed during a holiday weekend and still had no issues with parking, the elevators or finding a great spot on the beach. The kids loved the pool! The condo was very comfortable and kept cool. We never heard any neighbors, which was very nice compared to other places we have stayed. This is a great place to stay!

Loved this condo!  It felt like we were in a home and not a hotel.  Had everything we needed, washer, dryer, full kitchen, tvs, pools, just overall nice accommodations!! And best of all a perfect few of the ocean!  Would stay again in a heart beat!  The staff at the resort was kind and friendly as well.  First time doing Airbnb, awesome experience!

The view, location and sealife you'll see from balcony is amazing! it was the the most amazing time. my only complaint is the mattress. it's so broke down and uncomfortable. we ended up sleeping in the tiny room upfront with 2 twin beds, those mattresses are amazing and comfortable. some reviews mentioned the uncomfortable mattress but I thought surely not. no theyre correct. other than the mattress everything else was the best time and best experience ever.
